content.title: Indianapolis | Purdue Polytechnic
content.text: Location Intro Welcome to Purdue Polytechnic in Indianapolis, extending Purdue to Indianapolis. Indianapolis students enrolled in Purdue Polytechnic majors will join a prestigious college for technology and innovation. As Purdue grows to meet the needs of high-tech industries around the world, this extension to Indiana’s capital city sits at the center of the action. We are committed to creating a thriving hub of activity for all incoming students who want to bring technology of all kinds into the next generation. The urban experience of the futureEarn a Purdue degree via a Polytechnic major to meet the growing demands of Indianapolis, the State of Indiana, and beyond. This extension continues Purdue Polytechnic's legacy of excellence—Purdue's college for technology over nearly 60 years.Downtown Indianapolis is a vibrant city with a rich cultural heritage, sports, music, arts, and a diverse culinary scene. Indianapolis is also known for its thriving industries, including healthcare, education, finance, and technology, providing ample job opportunities for students post-graduation. TAKE YOUR NEXT GIANT LEAP If you have questions about Purdue Polytechnic in Indianapolis, feel free to reach out via email at techrecruit@purdue.edu. Our team is happy to provide more details about programs, campus visits, and the opportunities available to students in the heart of Indiana’s capital city.Contact UsWe are excited to welcome you to our vibrant community and look forward to supporting you as you embark on this new academic journey. If you're ready, accept your offer!Accept Your Offer Majors Offered in Indianapolis Build a customizable degree that blends technology, leadership, and design—giving you the skills to solve problems, manage projects, and innovate across multiple industries. Build the future of theme parks, museums and beyond with immersive experiences across digital, physical, and virtual worlds. Blend disciplines such as environmental design, architecture, technology, construction, art, and other trades to create indoor spaces that are both beautiful and functional. Learn leadership and business concepts for construction, renovation or restoration projects and prepare to be an effective leader and partner. Learn to create and maintain secure networks and ways to track down hackers who aim to breach that security. Keep your employer’s systems functioning efficiently and their data safe as you manage applications, databases and networks. Graduate Programs offered in Indianapolis Lead global technology initiatives, focus on innovation, leadership, and management for today’s evolving industries. Prepare for a career in cybersecurity by building expertise across IT, computing, and engineering to address real-world security challenges. Develop cutting-edge solutions in emerging fields like cybersecurity, data analytics, robotics, and healthcare computing. Minors offered at Purdue in Indianapolis Themed Entertainment Design Minor Explore the art of designing for theme parks, museums, and more with a flexible minor in Themed Entertainment Design—connect, create, and launch your dream career.
